_readme: GOLIVE-PREP-1. Data for scripts/golive-swap.js. swapSpots: the 7 values and where each lives (token + marker comment). labels: visible text of the five buy buttons after the swap. flips: the 'not offered / not open yet' lines. An edit with "new": null has NO verbatim go-live wording in Legal Mate's pack: the script refuses --write until Legal Mate or Lead supplies it. Pins use {{new:EDIT_ID}} for the new copy.
